answer.rationale: Daily settlement peaks are a known load pattern; the only new variable is the release that landed ~30 minutes before write-path p99 began climbing to 5x. memory_b1 is the closest playbook: rollback restored a stable prior build without dropping customer writes. Circuit breaking is rejected because failing fast would lose writes. add_capacity (memory_b3) was a before-the-peak provision, not an in-peak fix, and route_read_replicas (memory_b5) only helps if competing reads—not the heavy settlement writes—are the cause. Verifying b1 and b5 to check those two write-path recovery records before committing; residual uncertainty remains that load mix rather than the build is primary.
